# Heroes of the Jade Oath

Heroes of the Jade Oath is a rules and setting book by Rite Publishing that offers many new themes based on eastern Asian history and traditions, from new classes and archetypes to new casting options.

This wiki does *not* host information on the actual lands of the Jade Oath - for such setting information (and other content that cannot be hosted under the terms of the OGL), you can [[Support The Publishers|Support the Publishers]] by purchasing a copy of this book.
